# Location Drive MCP Server

> The official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Location Drive, the global point-of-interest data platform (350M+ verified places in 250+ countries and territories, 120M+ building polygons graded A–E, 80+ structured fields, 5M daily delta updates). It gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP-capable client 11 read-only tools for place search, proximity, building footprints, brand intelligence, LLM-ready place context, multi-year review history, neighborhood review scanning, and hotel rate comparison — hosted at https://mcp.locationdrive.com/mcp or run locally via `npx -y @locationdrive/mcp`.

The server is named `locationdrive` and is read-only by design. Both modes use
the customer's own Location Drive API key, so plan gating, quotas, and usage
metering apply exactly as for direct REST calls — the server adds no auth,
caching, or rate limiting of its own; `api.locationdrive.com` is the
enforcement point. Source: https://github.com/locationdrive/mcp (TypeScript,
MIT). The full platform summary for LLMs lives at
https://locationdrive.com/llms.txt.

Last updated: 2026-09-11.

## Connect — hosted (no install)

Streamable HTTP, stateless, at `https://mcp.locationdrive.com/mcp`.
Authenticate every request with `Authorization: Bearer ld_live_YOUR_KEY`
(unauthenticated requests get a 401 JSON error). Keys are self-serve at
https://locationdrive.com/signup.

Claude Code:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http locationdrive https://mcp.locationdrive.com/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ld_live_YOUR_KEY"
```

Cursor (`.cursor/mcp.json`) and other JSON-configured clients:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "locationdrive": {
      "url": "https://mcp.locationdrive.com/mcp",
      "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ld_live_YOUR_KEY" }
    }
  }
}
```

## Connect — local (stdio via npm)

npm package `@locationdrive/mcp` (bin `locationdrive-mcp`), Node >= 18, with
the key in the `LOCATIONDRIVE_API_KEY` environment variable.

Claude Code:

```bash
claude mcp add locationdrive -e LOCATIONDRIVE_API_KEY=ld_live_YOUR_KEY -- npx -y @locationdrive/mcp
```

JSON-configured clients (Claude Desktop and similar):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "locationdrive": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@locationdrive/mcp"],
      "env": { "LOCATIONDRIVE_API_KEY": "ld_live_YOUR_KEY" }
    }
  }
}
```

## The 11 tools

Each tool wraps a documented REST endpoint of `https://api.locationdrive.com/v1`:

- `search_places(query, country?, category?, limit≤20)` — search the global POI database by name or keyword; returns businesses with address, coordinates, rating, hours, contact info. Backs `GET /v1/places/search`. Free plan and above.
- `find_nearby(latitude, longitude, radius_m 50–100000?, category?, limit≤20)` — places around a coordinate, distance-sorted with `distance_m` added. Backs `GET /v1/places/nearby`. Free+.
- `get_place_details(place_id, fields?)` — full record for one place; `fields` takes a comma-separated list or `*` for all plan-eligible fields. Premium fields on Business+: `menu_items` (full menu as sections → items with structured prices), `hotel_details` (room-rate offers from multiple booking sites with links), `hotel_price`, `hotel_class`, `ev_connectors` (per-connector type, power_kw, speed, plug_count) plus `ev_connector_types`, `ev_network`, `ev_max_power_kw`, `ev_plug_count`, `ev_stall_count`, `ev_speed`, `fuel_price`, `reviews` (current-cycle review text), `historical_reviews` (review text from earlier crawls), `review_sentiments`. Backs `GET /v1/places/{id}`. If explicitly requested premium fields come back missing, the response carries a `plan_note` (the key's plan is below Business+) instead of silently omitting them.
- `get_place_context(place_id)` — LLM-ready context: a natural-language summary plus structured data including `review_sentiments` keyword counts (not review text), built for grounding answers about a specific business. Prefer it to describe or reason about a place overall; for what reviewers wrote, use get_review_history. Backs `GET /v1/ai/context/{id}`. Free+.
- `get_review_history(place_id)` — merged multi-year review text history, duplicates removed: current and historical reviews newest first, each tagged `source: "current"|"historical"`, with `reviews_meta` (unique_total, from_current, from_historical, duplicates_removed, oldest, newest), overall rating, rating distribution, and a sentiment summary. Backs `GET /v1/places/{id}/reviews/summary`. Business+.
- `scan_reviews(latitude, longitude, keywords[], radius_m?, category?, limit≤40, max_snippets_per_place?)` — keyword scan of review text across the nearest places: runs the nearby search, fetches each place's merged review history, and returns only the matching snippets per place (with rating, date, source) plus the scanned places that had no match. Matching is case-, diacritic-, and alef-variant-insensitive, so pass keywords in every relevant language, e.g. `["racist","عنصرية","hijab","حجاب","محجبة"]`. Cost: 1 + N API requests (N ≤ 40). Neighborhood scale only. Business+.
- `get_hotel_rates(place_id)` — compare room rates across booking sites for one hotel: headline nightly rate, star class, per-site offers with prices and links, check-in/check-out times. Backs `GET /v1/places/{id}` with the Hospitality fields. Hotel fields are Business+; on lower plans the response carries a `rates_note` explaining why no rates came back.
- `get_building_polygon(place_id, format geojson|wkt|both?)` — building footprint with A–E accuracy grade and area in m², GeoJSON ready for maps. Backs `GET /v1/polygons/{id}`. Starter+.
- `find_building_at_point(latitude, longitude)` — reverse building lookup: the footprint containing a coordinate and the business(es) inside. Location Drive's signature capability. Backs `GET /v1/polygons/contains`. Starter+.
- `brand_footprint(brand)` — brand intelligence summary: store counts by country, open-now count, polygon coverage, average rating. For market sizing and competitor analysis. Backs `GET /v1/brands/{brand}/summary`. Free+.
- `data_coverage(country?)` — per-country POI counts, or detailed polygon coverage with grade distribution for one ISO-2 country. Call this first when unsure whether a region is covered. Backs `GET /v1/countries` / `GET /v1/polygons/coverage`. Free+.

## Behavior, limits, and errors

- Every tool is annotated read-only; there are no write tools.
- Review text is per place. `reviews` (current crawl) and `historical_reviews` (earlier crawls) are Business+ fields on `get_place_details`; `get_review_history` returns both merged and de-duplicated. There is no city- or country-wide search over review content — `scan_reviews` covers a neighborhood (up to 40 places, one request each); beyond that, the question needs a backend review-search endpoint (roadmap).
- Premium fields are silently stripped below Business+. When explicitly requested fields are missing, `get_place_details` adds a `plan_note` saying so; treat missing review fields as a plan limit, never as "Location Drive has no review data".
- List tools return compact records (a slim default field set) and cap at 20 results — fetch full records per ID with `get_place_details`. Results are compact single-line JSON for token economy.
- Plan gating is enforced server-side by the API: polygon tools require Starter+; premium field packs (EV charging, fuel prices, full menus, hotel rates, review intelligence) and the `get_review_history` / `get_hotel_rates` tools require Business+. Gated calls return a clear upgrade message pointing at https://locationdrive.com/pricing rather than empty data; fields above plan are silently stripped from `get_place_details`.
- Error mapping: 401 → invalid or missing API key; 403 (`FORBIDDEN` / `PLAN_REQUIRED`) → the feature needs a higher plan; 429 (`RATE_LIMITED` / `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`) → the key's rate limit or monthly quota is exhausted. Errors come back as MCP tool errors with those messages, never transport failures.
- `ld_test_` keys work in both modes: synthetic data, zero quota use — ideal for trying the integration, demos, and CI.
- Rate limits and monthly quotas match the key's plan (Free 2 req/s and 50k req/mo up to Enterprise 200 req/s, unlimited). Heavy agent usage returning 429 means the key's quota is exhausted, not a server fault.

## Example prompts

- "What data coverage does Location Drive have for Anguilla?"
- "Find restaurants within 1 km of 18.2170, -63.0578."
- "Which building sits at 18.2168, -63.0581, and what's its accuracy grade?"
- "How many Starbucks locations are there worldwide, by country?"
- "Compare room rates for this hotel across booking sites."
- "How have this restaurant's reviews changed over the past few years?"
- "Which cafés within 1.5 km of 30.0289, 31.4910 have reviews mentioning racism or hijab (عنصرية، حجاب)?"

## Plans

Free $0 (50k requests/mo) · Starter $99/mo (adds building polygons and the
Advanced field pack) · Business $399/mo (adds the premium data packs — full
menus with structured prices, per-station EV connector detail, multi-site hotel
room rates, current + multi-year review history — plus a 99.99% SLA) ·
Enterprise custom. Full details and canonical pricing:
https://locationdrive.com/pricing.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/locationdrive/mcp): source, issues, and development setup.
- [@locationdrive/mcp on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@locationdrive/mcp): the local stdio package.
